comment: The GSA Android client is built into Defender. 'Global Secure Access' = 3 enables it by default
and removes the user's ability to disable it. Private Access is not used, so
'GlobalSecureAccessPrivateChannel' = 0 turns it off and hides its toggle; 0 is intended.
Both values are typed valueInteger: the Defender restriction schema (Intune designer) types
them as integers, and a mistyped valueString is not applied, which leaves Microsoft's
documented default where the user can switch GSA off. Plan/apply read the live schema
(GET only) and fail closed if Microsoft changes either key or type, and apply reads the
policy back after every write. Never edit this policy in the portal: the designer drops or
blanks values that do not match its schema, and the next deploy must then repair it.
The profile applies only to Android Device Owner enrollment. packageId uses the app: product
prefix returned by Intune for managed app configurations. Graph requires payloadJson to be
base64-encoded JSON, not a raw JSON string. The decoded value is:
name: android-defender-gsa-child

payload.description: Managed by sf-intune-cac. Do not edit in the portal.
